question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Vanquish
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Conquer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Vanquish"** means to defeat thoroughly or completely in a competition or conflict. (पराजित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The army was able to vanquish the enemy forces after a long battle.
 
 
 
• **"Conquer" **refers to overcoming or taking control of a place or people by use of military force; it also implies successfully overcoming a problem or weakness. (विजय प्राप्त करना)
 
 
• **Example: **Alexander the Great set out to conquer the known world.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'vanquish' **is **'conquer'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Conquer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Verify **(सत्यापित करना): Make sure or demonstrate that something is true, accurate, or justified.

 
 
• **Example:** The data needs to be verified before we can proceed with the analysis.
 
 
 
• **Describe **(वर्णन करना): Give an account in words of someone or something, including all the relevant characteristics, qualities, or events.
 
 
• **Example: **Can you describe the appearance of the suspect?
 
 
 
• **Quantify** (मात्रा निर्धारित करना): Express or measure the quantity of something.
 
 
• **Example:** It’s difficult to quantify the impact of his work on the community.
